findings.summary: No issue found about Label moving from Radix to Base UI; only unrelated Slider/Checkbox/Button issues matched.
First page of results had no Label/Radix-migration/double-click-selection issue.

notChecked: Reddit, Hacker News, blogs, radix-ui/primitives issues
pages beyond the first of the GitHub searches

differences.reference: Radix Label calls preventDefault on mousedown when detail > 1, so double-clicking a label does not select its text.
differences.branch: base-nova Label is a plain <label>; double-click selects the label text (mousedown with detail 2 is not default-prevented).
differences.how: On /gallery#components scroll to #label, dispatch new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,detail:2}) on a label: Radix defaultPrevented=true, Base false. Or double-click the 'Inline label' text and see it highlight.

apiChanges: Label no longer wraps a primitive: props type becomes React.ComponentProps<'label'> (Radix LabelPrimitive.Root props such as asChild no longer accepted). No consumer used asChild.
notes: Look was identical in the 1280-wide screenshots (same classes, same computed heights 14px/16px). The browser window did not actually resize to 390x844 (innerWidth stayed 1280), so mobile was not checked. Keyboard, focus and label-for association are the same native label behaviour either way; not exercised separately.
reasonNotMoved: base-nova Label is a plain <label> element, not a Base UI primitive, and drops Radix's double-click text-selection prevention (verified by dispatching mousedown with detail=2 on the reference and on the swapped local build). Visuals were identical. Retry if the difference is accepted as tolerable or the base-nova label adds onMouseDown preventDefault for detail > 1.
